actions.sql: SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE COUNT(*) FROM order_line WHERE ol_i_id BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND ol_quantity >= 5 AND ol_amount BETWEEN 10 AND 20

success_criteria: EXPLAIN shows table scan (type=ALL) on order_line for the injected SQL
At least one slow query logged or p95 latency increases by >=1.5x during injection
Observed QPS drops (ratio <= 0.7) during injection window

risks: Increased CPU and IO utilization due to full table scans on large table
Potential interference with TPCC background workload causing latency spikes
Buffer pool churn and cache eviction
mitigations: Limit concurrency to 2 and duration to 12 seconds to fit observe window
Use SELECT only (no writes) to avoid data corruption
Bounded by max_duration_sec and monitored during injection window
